column1: #gem5 SE/FS preset: 16 tiles on a 4x4 grid2d Network with XY routing
column3: one LLC bank per tile (8 MiB in total); DRAM (MCsim DDR4) behind a point-to-point bus. Tile t = router t: core t's instruction L1 (id t)
column4: data L1 (id 16+t) and LLC bank 64+t. Use with se_arm.py/fs_arm.py --octopus-config MultiCoreSystem_gem5_mesh and --num-cores 1..16

column5: #gem5 L1 bridges: instruction caches are ids 0-15 and data caches 16-31 (octopus_cache_hierarchy.py); fewer gem5 cores leave the rest idle

#the network runs at the core clock (one router/link tick = one gem5 cycle)
